mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 58 degrees and a beautiful first quarter moon in the sky, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight.
For city news, the VHAT cable channel is your resource for local government meetings and community info, while new regulations are in place regarding how many vehicles you can park at your residence.
There is a lot going on today, including yoga at Insight Wellness, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, followed by Concerts in the Park tomorrow.
In a notable call from July 13, a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after their vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Today's flavor of the day is Mint Explosion, which sounds fantastic. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM today.
